purpose: Prove the walker descends into an OPEN shadow root and resolves accessible names against the shadow root that owns the element - not against the outer document.
targeted_defect: BUG-SHADOW-NAME: walk() recurses host.shadowRoot but forwards the OUTER `doc` (inventory_js.py:648). accessibleName()/idText() therefore run label[for=] and aria-labelledby id lookups against the wrong root, so every shadow-scoped label is invisible and the control comes back name=''.
